products.name: Turnitin AI Detection
products.note: AI writing detection; academic integrity; false positive risk; student data privacy (FERPA)

profile_text.body:
Turnitin is an education technology company whose products, per its own site, are designed to promote academic integrity, streamline grading and feedback, deter plagiarism, and improve student outcomes. The company describes its tools as purpose-built for education and positions them around originality verification, AI writing detection, and secure assessment delivery. Its database is described on its site as the world's largest academic database for comparing student work.

Turnitin's primary AI product is Turnitin AI Detection, which the site describes as identifying AI-generated writing and bringing writing analytics and AI insights together to guide responsible AI use. The tool is offered with integration into learning management systems and is also applied to documents such as grant proposals, theses, and dissertations. The company also offers a secure exam product that locks down devices to block the internet, integrated AI tools, and notes, and can verify student identity and deliver exams offline.

The site's held facts note that Turnitin AI Detection carries considerations around false positive risk and student data privacy under FERPA, which are relevant areas of scrutiny for tools of this kind in educational settings. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
